verdict.rationale: Cal.com exposes an explicitly versioned API (v2 paths such as POST /v2/bookings), and its official CLI is described as handling versioning automatically. It also marks the Platform auth method as "Deprecated". However, no documented deprecation policy (timelines, sunset notices, migration guarantees) appears anywhere in the evidence. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, details of the version-pinning mechanism, changelog or migration guidance, and independent corroboration of version stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: POST /v2/bookings is used to create regular bookings, recurring bookings and instant bookings.
The CLI handles authentication, versioning, and common workflows automatically.
The Cal.com API has 3 authentication methods: 1. OAuth 2. API key 3. Platform (Deprecated)
Cal.com offers a v2 REST API
